scenarios.title: A spell can be cast for its freerunning cost only after an Assassin dealt combat damage to a player
decisions: A moves to combat and attacks B with Assassin Initiate only.
B declares no blockers; combat damage is dealt; combat ends and the game moves to A's second main phase.
A, with priority in main2 and two untapped Islands, considers casting Eagle Vision for its freerunning cost {1}{U}.

variants.label: assassin_connects
variants.expected: Assassin Initiate deals 1 combat damage to B (life 19). Casting Eagle Vision for its freerunning cost {1}{U} is legal.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B blocks Assassin Initiate with Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Assassin Initiate deals its damage to Grizzly Bears, so no player is dealt combat damage this turn (B stays at 20). Casting Eagle Vision for its freerunning cost is not legal; its full cost {4}{U} cannot be paid with two Islands either.

variants.label: non_assassin
variants.delta: A attacks with Grizzly Bears instead of Assassin Initiate.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B (life 18), but it is not an Assassin. Casting Eagle Vision for its freerunning cost is not legal.

variants.label: no_attack
variants.expected: No combat damage is dealt this turn. Casting Eagle Vision for its freerunning cost is not legal.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge checks Player.hasFreerunning() when the cast is attempted. A commander branch cannot be set up with these cards and is not illustrated.
